info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Feedback API
info.description: Provides API methods for submitting product feedback and managing feedback reminders.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Name of the feature the feedback is about.
Whether the user likes the feature.
Optional selected multiple-choice answer.
Feedback message entered by the user.

request.description: Sends a survey response to the Matomo team or to the configured feedback email address.

response.name:
Translation key text when validation fails, or `success` when the feedback email is sent.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
